name: Solve It: A visual novel
source:
Matthew Park was fabulously wealthy, had a beautiful wife, and was renowned for his genius. In short, he had it all - that is, until he was murdered. There's no shortage of suspects you must investigate to find the killer. Was it his son who he constantly yelled at, his wife who would inherit everything, or his investor who was disappointed in his performance?

[From [url=https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=com.solve.it.visual.novel.death.of.a.ceo.text.adventure]Google Play[/url]]
translation:
Matthew Park曾腰纏萬貫，擁有一位美麗的妻子，更以過人的才智聞名。總之，他曾擁有一切——直到他遭人謀殺。你必須調查所有嫌疑人，找出兇手。是他總愛大聲斥責的兒子？是將繼承他全部財產的妻子？還是對他表現失望的投資人？

[來源：[url=https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=com.solve.it.visual.novel.death.of.a.ceo.text.adventure]Google Play[/url]]
